name: smwgraphics-f-zero-font
title: F-Zero - Font
description:
This is a port of the 8x12 font found in F-Zero for the SNES that is used for the timer and "LAPS LEFT" messages but is typeset to be 8x16 and expanded to include a full character set.

Suitable for credits, cutscenes or any other in-level text.
